notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2][b]Gameplay:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fireflies now carry over between levels[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tutorials for a smoother onboarding experience[/p][/*][*][p]You can now return to Farmland from the Rat Kingdom[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed UI issues, including score display and overlapping menus[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several spots where players could get stuck or leave the play area[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.0.1 First Day Patch Notes
notes.content: [h2]Gameplay:[/h2][list][*][p]Rats are fully functional now and will chase Dillo to stop him from beating forts[/p][/*][*][p]Save System improved[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Save system is fully implemented:[/h2][list][*][p]Compatible for all levels (Dillo Pad, Farmland, Rat Kingdom, Cave Fort, Rat King Fight )[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogues/Dialogue Sequencers[/p][/*][*][p]Destructibles[/p][/*][*][p]Ratkingdom stuff (bells, bellsystem, belltowerTrigger, pingajar),[/p][/*][*][p]Key Saves[/p][/*][*][p]Gates Saves[/p][/*][*][p]Respawn Points[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where starting a new game with the menu while another game is running would cause you to respawn at the last respawn point of the level[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where saving inside a respawn point would lead to problems and messy behavior when loading the saved game[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-Save calls are added to Respawn Points, on level start, and at the end of forts[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dillo's Dilemma is Here!
notes.content: [h2][b]Hey, Explorers![/b][/h2][p]Dillo’s full adventure is here![/p][p]Roll, bounce, and ricochet your way through a pinball-infused love letter to classic adventure collectathons, where arcade nostalgia meets a fresh, fast-paced twist.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s in the full game?[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Core Pinball-Adventure Mechanics[/b] – Master Dillo’s self-made roll ‘n’ ricochet gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Different Worlds[/b] – Explore large, open levels packed with secrets, puzzles, and hidden treasures.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hand-Crafted Fort Levels[/b] – Race against the clock while swarms of rats chase you down.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Collect them all [/b]– Collect all fireflies scattered around the world![/p][/*][*][p][b]Story and Antagonist [/b]– Discover the Dilemma that set Dillo on his journey and face the cunning Rat King![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Friends & Foes[/b] – Team up with Frank the firefly and other armadillos on your quest to free the world.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]You can also subscribe to our social media to find some more fun stuff about Dillo in the future![/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/moonspice_games/?locale=es_US"]Instagram[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@moonspicegames?lang=en"]TikTok [/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for rolling with us.[/p][p]-MoonSpice Games[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Dillo's Demo is Here!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey, Explorers![/b][/h2][p]
We’re rolling into Steam Next Fest with a demo of Dillo – our pinball-infused love letter to classic adventure collectathon games. Buckle up and be ready to bounce around, and feel that arcade nostalgia with a fresh twist!
[/p][h3][b]What’s in the Demo?[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Core Pinball-Adventure Mechanics[/b] – try out Dillo’s self-made roll ‘n’ ricochet gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hand-Crafted Fort Level[/b] – test your skills and show how fast you can beat the level while swarms of rats keep behind your tail![/p][/*][*][p][b]Feedback Provision[/b] – tell us what you loved (or what you hated). We would love to improve our game![/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h3][b]Coming after Demo[/b][/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Online Co-op [/b]– you will be able to team up or troll friends while battling rat swarms. Push them into trouble or pull them to safety. Your choice to make![/p][p][b]More Forts [/b]–[b] [/b]new challenges, more tricky ways to beat rats, and more objectives![/p][p][b]Collectables and World Challenges [/b]– more world challenges and collectables will await you when the game fully releases! Will you be able to find all the fireflies?[/p][p][b]Story and Antagonist [/b]– you will find out why a certain mysterious and whimsical armadillo is occupying forts and supporting a rebellion.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Don’t forget to Wishlist and Follow to find out more about Armadillo named Dillo and his adventures[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Full Release is August 2025!

[/b]You can also subscribe to our social media to find some more fun stuff about Dillo in the future!
[url="https://www.instagram.com/moonspice_games/?locale=es_US"]Instagram[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@moonspicegames?lang=en"]TikTok [/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for rolling with us. We can’t wait to share even more exciting things soon![/p][p]-MoonSpice Games[/p][p] [/p]
